columns.name: OPERATION_KEY
columns.semantics: Paid/customer rows use the stable sylvara.crm-billing.idempotency.v1 HMAC domain. sync_report_summary rows use sylvara.crm-report-summary.v1 and bind environment, Deal, deployment, configuration, report schema, canonical call-set digest, full canonical report-revision digest, and action so a changed terminal report creates a new immutable operation.

columns.name: OPERATION_FINGERPRINT
columns.semantics: Paid/customer rows use sylvara.crm-billing.idempotency.v1 to bind accepted commercial evidence. sync_report_summary rows use sylvara.crm-report-summary.v1 to bind the full canonical sanitized payload and its revision-specific operation identity.

columns.name: CRM_DEAL_ID
columns.semantics: Legacy physical column: CRM Deal ID for public lifecycle rows; CRM Account ID for the private provision_test_customer row.

columns.name: SOURCE_REVISION
columns.semantics: Immutable creation audit evidence. Reconciliation verifies operation identity and Development environment but does not require equality to the current deployment revision.

columns.name: LAST_OUTCOME
columns.semantics: Report rows start terminal_report_ready; a reclaimable pre-write owner stores report_claim_<32-hex>; exact report_write_started_<32-hex> readback is required before CRM PUT and is never automatically reclaimed; only authoritative CRM readback stores report_summary_readback_confirmed with STATUS completed.

columns.name: OPERATION_PAYLOAD_JSON
columns.semantics: Exact sanitized terminal report-summary payload. Raw call data, caller data, Results_Review_At, and paid acceptance are prohibited.

columns.name: OPERATION_VERSION
columns.semantics: Every report claim, write-start, completion, or containment transition increments this cursor. Completion and containment compare ROWID, STATUS, LAST_OUTCOME, and OPERATION_VERSION; a changed semantic state is never overwritten. After the operation cursor is observed, every completion transition and completed replay requires fresh exact Deal account/binding/patch readback. A mismatch CAS-keeps or demotes reconciliation; if stale containment first observes a winning completion, one fresh read and at most one repair CAS may converge it.

report_summary_outbox.consumer: crm_billing_orchestrator action sync_report_summary on its existing authenticated route
report_summary_outbox.replay: An exact report revision reuses its OPERATION_KEY and immutable fingerprint/payload. A changed canonical report gets a different revision-specific key. Pending or processing report_claim pre-write rows may be atomically claimed/reclaimed with an OPERATION_VERSION fence. After exact report_write_started readback, processing or reconciliation_required rows never repeat the CRM write and converge only through exact Deal readback. Report completion and containment are compare-and-set transitions over ROWID, STATUS, LAST_OUTCOME, and OPERATION_VERSION; one bounded retry tolerates only a cursor advance with unchanged status/outcome, never a semantic conflict.
report_summary_outbox.migration_gate: Add the four nullable columns without modifying legacy rows; read back exact types, privacy, encrypted-text audit consent, and multiple legacy null behavior before enabling either producer or consumer.

shared_tables.role: producer-only sanitized conversion_status v2 facts after authoritative CRM/Billing and operation completion readback
